fields.description:
**Goal:** Understand how deals/links are configured today in Airtable and how the operator-report reconciliation works — the heart of the fraud/gap problem.

**To cover:**

* Multi-factor Deal setup in Airtable: who creates Operators/Partners, when, how often
* How deals are allocated/distributed to reps; dynamic assignment of operator-provided affiliate links
* Operator reports vs rep-logged signups: how reconciliation runs today, where the gaps appear (delays, missed logs, fraud)
* How the forecast (manual logs) differs from operator-confirmed conversions — the data the real-time pipeline must replace

**Inputs needed:** Sample Airtable deal/link config; sample operator report.
fields.summary: Discovery: Deep dive with Ali on Operator/Partner Configuration in Airtable, Operator Reports vs Signup Reconciliation,
